slides.title: Hybi's 1-minute snow prep
slides.sub: Three times a week, nice and slow!

sections.heading: 1. Single-leg bridge
lines: ① Lie on your back, knees bent.
② Lift one foot, press through the other heel.
③ Lift your hips, hold 3 sec, lower slowly.
④ 8 each side, 3 times a week.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: Knee or back pain gets worse, or the
knee feels like it gives way — stop and ask.

caption:
Toto's snow trip is a month away. Last year her thighs were done by lunch on day one.

Skiing and snowboarding ask your legs, balance and trunk to work together for hours. Starting some steady strength work a few weeks before you go can help your legs cope with long days on the slopes.

Hybi's 1-minute prep: single-leg bridge, hold 3 seconds, 8 each side, 3 times a week. Stop if pain gets worse.

A knee that gives way, swelling after a fall, or pain lasting more than two weeks is worth an assessment. Clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio can help you build a plan. Book online via the link in bio ⛷

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
